page.layout: One page, a single column of Hebrew lexicon entries, with a Hebrew running head at the top and the page number 66 at top right. A Hebrew signature mark sits at the bottom right.

main_text.l: דְּבַשׁ m. Mel: Palma, Dactylus, juxta Hebraos, 2.Par.31.5,
דָּגַל Vexillari, id est, Vexillo erecto uti, Vexillum erigere.
דַּד m. uber, Mamma: Duale, דַּדַּיִם.
דרה Hithpahel הִתְדַּהְדֵּר Vagari, Incedere, Gradi sensim & leniter.
מְדַהֲבָה f. Aurea, Aurifica, Auri cupida.
דּוּג Piscari. Hiphil וַיָּדִיגוּ Et piscabuntur eos, Jer. 16.16: pro וְהֵדִיגוּם.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation in several entries is hard to read at this scan resolution and is copied approximately; forms marked as uncertain are not verified letter by letter. The running head and signature are Hebrew letters as printed. The Hebrew entry "דרה" at the head of the Hithpahel line is probably a catchword or a printed form and is not certain.
